newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fiat to recall some Brava models - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Fiat to recall some Brava models - newspaper.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat has planned a recall action for its Fiat Brava model due to problems with the braking system, Germany's Bild Zeitung said on Thursday.

The newspaper quoted a Fiat spokesman as saying the 1.4-litre engine version of the car, which was named car of the year in 1996 by a number of trade publications, would be affected by the recall action.
"Yes, we have confirmed that under certain conditions there are irregularities with the brakes," the newspaper quoted Fiat spokesman Claus Witzeck as saying.
The newspaper did not say how many vehicles would be affected by the recall action.
A Fiat spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
